name: Early Death
overview: Scripture acknowledges the brevity and frailty of human life, emphasizing that man is born for only a short time and is full of trouble, as seen in Job 14:1. The psalmist prays for understanding of life's limited span to live wisely (Psalms 39:4; 90:12) and recognizes that God may shorten days through affliction (Psalms 102:23). Ecclesiastes cautions against wickedness and folly that can lead to dying before one's appointed time, while Isaiah comforts believers by explaining that the righteous who die early are taken away from coming evil, highlighting God's mercy and sovereign care (Ecclesiastes 7:17; Isaiah 57:1).
